INSERT INTO raw_events (
    external_id,
    payload,
    event_source,
    processing_status,
    error_message,
    manual_review_reason,
    processed_at,
    updated_at
)
VALUES (
    COALESCE(
        '{{ $('Event Normalization').first().json.external_id }}',
        'missing_external_id_' || EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::text
    ),
    '{{ JSON.stringify($('When clicking ‘Execute workflow’').item.json) }}'::jsonb,
    '{{ $('Event Normalization').first().json.event_source }}',
    'manual_review',
    'Validation failed: {{ $('Event Normalization').first().json.validation_errors.join(", ") }}',
    'Invalid lead payload: {{ $('Event Normalization').first().json.validation_errors.join(", ") }}',
    NOW(),
    NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (external_id) DO UPDATE
SET processing_status = 'manual_review',
    error_message = EXCLUDED.error_message,
    manual_review_reason = EXCLUDED.manual_review_reason,
    updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING internal_id, external_id;
